recipe.visualDefinition: A split-screen composition featuring two high-contrast, warm-toned photographs of musicians performing, topped by a vibrant green horizontal header containing bold, stacked, multi-colored typography with hard drop shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal division between a solid color header and a photographic base
Vertical division separating two distinct performance portraits
Color-coded typographic hierarchy against a saturated green background
Contrast between the warm, dark photography and the bright, flat graphic header
coreInvariants: Hard, dark blue drop shadows on all display text
Heavy black shadows in the photographic subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy equal halves of the bottom two-thirds; the left subject is seated at a piano, the right subject is standing in profile.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright green header strip at the top acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large yellow text, move down to the white text, then scan the two photographic portraits from left to right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows within the photographs provide significant negative space for the subjects to emerge from.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the header vs. high value contrast in the dark photography.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the top line
High contrast and heavy slabs for the bottom line
Hard, offset drop shadows at a 45-degree angle
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrasting a low-contrast sans-serif with a high-contrast slab-serif for visual variety within a unified block.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric sans-serif top line skeleton.
Captures the heavy slab-serif feel of the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen image. The top 30% is a solid Kelly green rectangle. The bottom 70% is divided vertically into two halves. The left half shows a man in a suit and sunglasses playing a piano in warm amber stage lighting with heavy black shadows. The right half shows a woman in a light-colored dress singing in profile against a dark background, also in warm amber lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of uppercase text over the green header. The top line should be yellow with a navy blue drop shadow using a bold geometric sans-serif. The bottom line should be white with a navy blue drop shadow using a heavy slab-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the header a solid green block?
Are there two distinct photographic panels below the header?
Does the text have hard, dark blue drop shadows?
Is the lighting in the photos warm and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of amber in the lighting
Font weight of the display text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the green header is perfectly horizontal.
Verify the drop shadows are consistent in angle and color.
Check that the two photos feel like they belong to the same session/style.
Confirm the slab-serif text is significantly heavier than the sans-serif text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color header + Split-screen high-contrast photography + Multi-font bold typography with hard shadows.
